{{Quote|Back in the Clone Wars, the Seppies captured Ongary IX, looking for hfredium. They took over the mines and converted the central shafts into starfighter bases, with hot and cold running Vulture droids pouring out at dusk and dawn to make trouble.|Jorn Kulish|<ref name="Author's Cut" />}}
'''Ongary IX''' was a [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] astronomical object located in the [[Ividal sector/Legends|Ividal sector]]. It featured [[hfredium]] [[Mining/Legends|mines]] that were converted into [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droid starfighter]] bases when the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] captured the celestial body during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

When the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] planned to [[Attack on Ongary IX|eliminate]] the Confederacy bases on Ongary IX, the [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]] of the [[Ividal Sector Forces]]' [[Foxfire Squadron]] were equipped with [[burrowing plasma charge]]s for [[bombing run]]s. The brightness of the [[Missile/Legends|warheads']] detonation caused problems for the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]], however, leading to Republic [[Technician/Legends|technicians]] outfitting the [[Squadron/Legends|squadron's]] [[Flight helmet/Legends|helmets]] with opaque [[Blast shield/Legends|blast shields]]. The subsequent [[Bomber/Legends|bombing]] run succeeded in destroying one of the Confederacy bases on Ongary IX, and the Headhunter starfighters were [[Transport/Legends|transported]] back to the Ividal Sector Forces' base the following [[Standard day/Legends|day]].

==Description==
{{Quote|After 10 or 15 seconds I finally got the chin strap loose and yanked my helmet off, just in time to see a kriffing ''mountain'' going by two meters to starboard.|Jorn Kulish|<ref name="Author's Cut" />}}
Ongary IX was a terrestrial astronomical object<ref name="Author's Cut" /> located in the [[Ongary system/Legends|Ongary system]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="Slice" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> A [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] was located on the celestial body's surface, and [[hfredium]],<ref name="Author's Cut" /> a metal used in [[Starship/Legends|starship]] construction,<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|39|hfredium}}</ref> was extracted in several [[Mining/Legends|mines]] featuring central shafts.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

==History==
===Strategic mines===
{{Quote|A day before the third hop, they collected our helmets and brought them back with blast shields you could flip down over your face. ''[&hellip;]'' They told us to keep the blast shield up until it was time to fire the charges, snap it down, then pop it back up when the flash had dissipated.|Jorn Kulish|<ref name="Author's Cut" />}}
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] captured Ongary IX due to its interest in the hfredium reserves. The Confederacy took over the astronomical object's mines and converted their central shafts into bases for its [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droid starfighters]], which departed the facilities for confrontations at both dawn and dusk.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

[[File:BlastShield-ANH.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The flight helmets of Republic starfighter pilots were outfitted with blast shields for bombing runs on Ongary IX.]]
The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] intended to [[Attack on Ongary IX|eliminate]] the Confederacy bases on Ongary IX at some point during the conflict but was unable to spare its [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]], which were engaged in a military operation at [[Uvadala]]. Instead, the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] recruited the local [[Ividal Sector Forces]], outfitting the [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]] of its [[Foxfire Squadron]] with [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]] [[burrowing plasma charge]]s to allow them to function as [[Bomber/Legends|bombers]].<ref name="Author's Cut" />

Foxfire Squadron subsequently carried out several [[bombing run]]s against Confederacy targets on Ongary IX. However, the detonation of the Headhunters' [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] [[Missile/Legends|warheads]] was unexpectedly bright, and as a result the [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] [[Jens (pilot)|Jens]] and [[Rafana]] became distracted and were [[Death/Legends|killed]]. After the second bombing run, Republic [[Technician/Legends|technicians]] outfitted the Foxfire Squadron's [[Flight helmet/Legends|flight helmets]] with opaque, hinged [[Plastoid/Legends|plastoid]] [[Blast shield/Legends|blast shields]] that could be flipped down over a pilot's face when the plasma charges were fired.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

===Flying blind===
{{Quote|Because my commo gear had come off with my helmet, it took me 20 minutes to figure out we'd imploded the mine, bringing the Seppies' whole base down on top of them.|Jorn Kulish|<ref name="Author's Cut" />}}
The bombing run of the following [[Standard day/Legends|day]] targeted one of the hfredium mines. Foxfire Squadron engaged a screen of Vulture [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droids]] in an intense dogfight before firing the plasma charges. The Headhunter pilots flipped their blast shields, flying blind until the warheads vectored in on their targets and exploded. The pilot [[Jorn Kulish]] flew through the dogfights at an altitude of thirty [[Meter/Legends|meters]], forced to wait for eight [[Standard second|seconds]] until the detonation of the missile, only to realize that the blast shield of the [[Helmet/Legends|helmet]] had become stuck.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

[[File:StellarEnvoy-SWE.png|thumb|right|250px|The pilot Jorn Kulish left Ongary IX aboard the freighter ''Stellar Envoy''.]]
Kulish struggled with the chin strap of the helmet for ten to fifteen seconds before finally yanking it off, only to notice that the swerving starfighter passed a mountain at a distance of merely two meters. That day's bombing run was a success for the Republic's forces, with the target mine imploding and burying the entire Confederacy base.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

The next day, Foxfire Squadron's Headhunter starfighters were loaded aboard a Republic [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] bound to return to the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] [[Planetary Security Forces|forces']] base at the celestial body [[Ividal]]. Due to experience of the Ongary IX attack, however, Kulish decided to leave the service, instead leaving the celestial body as a passenger aboard the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Coreward]]-bound<ref name="Author's Cut" /> [[Republic Group/Legends|Republic Group]]<ref name="Millennium">[[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']]</ref> [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Stellar Envoy'']].<ref name="Author's Cut" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ongary IX was originally meant to be mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]]; however, the section that would have mentioned the celestial body was cut before the book's release.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

The information regarding Ongary IX was later released in [[2014]] as part of [[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut]], a series of articles published on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|Blog]] by Fry and<ref name="Author's Cut" /> [[Del Rey]] editor<ref name="Celestials">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-the-celestials|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut — The Celestials|int=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut}}</ref> [[Erich Schoeneweiss]] containing various cut content from ''The Essential Guide to Warfare''.<ref name="Author's Cut" /> The StarWars.com [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Ongary [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Ongary IX, in grid square P-14.<ref name="EAOC" />
